patronOf.en-US: The mercy of the risen Christ

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Bring your hand and feel the place of the nails, and do not be unbelieving but believing, alleluia.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Coloca aqui a tua mão e reconhece o lugar dos cravos, e não sejas incrédulo, mas fiel, aleluia.

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; a plain gold halo; the lids a little lowered, the gaze turned gently DOWN toward the viewer as in Kazimirowski's painting. The wounds show only as small, clean marks on the hands and feet.
meta.basis: Kazimirowski's 1934 painting, the first image of the devotion, painted at Vilnius under St. Faustina's direction: Christ in white, blessing with the right hand, the left at the breast, the pale and red rays. Christ keeps the set's face, with the painting's lowered gaze.
